name: Candy Pink
lede: Candy Pink is a warm, strong pink listed in the 1955 ISCC-NBS system, and a name whose old and modern swatches differ a good deal.

sections.title: A name that moved
sections.body:
Candy Pink appears in the ISCC-NBS system of 1955, in the 1930 Maerz and Paul dictionary it cites, and in the 2010 xkcd survey [1]. The swatch here is a warm coral-leaning pink, nearest ISCC-NBS name "deep pink" at a distance of 1.1 [1]. The xkcd list uses the same words for a much more purple pink, #FF63E9, so the name does not fix one color [1]. Compare [[deep-pink]] and [[cotton-candy]].

Paterson glosses candy-coloured as having a shade of pink, also "candy pink", and candy-striped as pink and white stripes [2]. Finlay finds candy pink hiding inside the wool of a Harris tweed, beside heather purple and sun yellow [3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: The swatch appears in 7 of our 23,781 paintings, 0.03 percent, as photographed [4]. That is rarer than 86 percent of named colors [4]. Look to [[pink]] and [[rose-pink]] for the wider family.
